snippet.title: Modern Modern Chef - Release & Download Trailer!
snippet.description:
Download it here!
https://bunnynaut.itch.io/modern-modern-chef

A remake of a classic Game Boy Color remake! This game started as a project to teach myself a difficult coding language and eventually turned into a bigger ordeal than I anticipated. I hope you get a chance to enjoy it!

The menus, the characters, the bg's all hand-drawn and animated by me. The game's code was also done by me with help from various friends and online resources.

The game's music and sounds were made with the help of my buddy Jacob Strick, and you can see his website and other social links here: https://www.jacobstrick.com/

Also a tremendous thank you to youtube channel Retro Game Mechanics Explained for helping me with making sure that Modern Modern Chef could be as accurate as possible to the original Game Boy Color game. Check out their channel here: https://www.youtube.com/@RGMechEx

This is an entirely free fangame and I hold no affiliation to Nintendo or any claim of ownership over the characters!
